description_en: Modifies the description of a cluster
kebab_example: aliyun polardb modify-db-cluster-description-zonal --db-cluster-id pc-00000000000000 --db-cluster-description pc-0000000000000000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDBClusterDescriptionZonal

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

Note: This API operation applies only to edge clusters. Edge clusters must be created by calling CreateDBCluster(CloudProvider=ENS, EnsRegionId=xxx) and can be queried by calling DescribeDBClustersZonal. For standard clusters, use ModifyDBClusterDescription
parameters.help_zh:
集群 ID。

注意：本 API 仅操作边缘集群，需通过 CreateDBCluster(CloudProvider=ENS, EnsRegionId=xxx) 创建，可通过 DescribeDBClustersZonal 查询；标准集群请用 ModifyDBClusterDescription
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The cluster name. The cluster name must meet the following requirements:

It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.
It must be 2 to 256 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
集群名称，集群名称需满足如下要求：

不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。
长度为 2~256 个字符
parameters.name: db_cluster_description

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request and prevent duplicate submissions. The value is generated by the client and must be unique across different requests. It is case-sensitive and can contain up to 64 ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，保证在不同请求间唯一，大小写敏感、不超过 64 个 ASCII 字符
parameters.name: client_token
